interface.signature: floodFill(image: List[List[int]], sr: int, sc: int, newColor: int) -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.description: The number of rows in the image is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of columns in the image is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The starting row index sr is within the bounds of the image.
The starting column index sc is within the bounds of the image.
The new color is an integer between 0 and 10 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The result has the same number of rows as the input image.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(result[i]) for i, row in enumerate(image))
postconditions.description: Each row in the result has the same number of columns as the corresponding row in the input image.

postconditions.expression: all(all(result[i][j] == newColor or image[i][j] != newColor for j in range(len(image[0]))) for i in range(len(image)))
postconditions.description: Every pixel in the result that is the same color as the newColor is either originally the newColor or is connected to a pixel of the original color.

postconditions.expression: all(all(result[i][j] == image[i][j] for j in range(len(image[0]))) or result[i][j] == newColor for i in range(len(image)))
postconditions.description: Every pixel in the result that is not the newColor is either the same as the original pixel or is connected to a pixel of the original color.
